description_en: Retrieves the details of a Public DNS AppKey
description_zh: 获取公共DNS AppKey 详情
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-pdns-app-key --app-key-id example-string --lang example-string --auth-code example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePdnsAppKey

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the Public DNS AppKey to query or manage
parameters.help_zh: 要查询或操作的公共 DNS AppKey 标识
parameters.name: app_key_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies the language for the request and response. Valid values: zh for Chinese and en for English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文；默认为 zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The verification code used to query the details of the AppKey secret
parameters.help_zh: 用于查询 AppKey 密钥详情的验证码
parameters.name: auth_code

AppKey.description_en: The details of the Public DNS AppKey
AppKey.description_zh: 公共 DNS AppKey 详情

AppKeyId.description_en: The identifier of the Public DNS AppKey
AppKeyId.description_zh: 公共 DNS AppKey 标识

AppKeySecret.description_en: The AppKey secret used to call Public DNS. Keep the secret confidential
AppKeySecret.description_zh: AppKey 密钥，用于调用公共 DNS 服务；应妥善保管

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the AppKey was created. The time is displayed in UTC+8 in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
CreateDate.description_zh: AppKey 创建时间，北京时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The creation timestamp of the AppKey in milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: AppKey 创建时间的毫秒时间戳

Remark.description_en: The remark entered when the AppKey is created or modified
Remark.description_zh: 创建或修改 AppKey 时填写的备注

State.description_en: The status of the AppKey. Valid values: OPENED: enabled. CLOSED: disabled
State.description_zh: AppKey 状态：OPENED 表示开启，CLOSED 表示关闭
